# WROUGHT

> The training and nutrition memory that lives inside your AI. One sentence a
> day, it remembers the rest — and tells you the truth about the week you had.

Wrought is an MCP server, not an app. It attaches to any assistant that speaks
the Model Context Protocol and gives that assistant a persistent, personal
record: what the user ate, what they lifted, what the scale said, and whatever
their watch reported overnight.

## The problem it solves

People open a new chat every morning and re-explain themselves — yesterday's
food, yesterday's training, this morning's weight — to a model with no memory of
any of it. Wrought is the memory that survives the tab closing.

## Connect

MCP endpoint:      https://wrought.fit/mcp
Transport:         Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0, stateless
Protocol version:  2025-06-18
Auth:              OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration (RFC 7591)
Discovery:         https://wrought.fit/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
                   https://wrought.fit/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

A conforming MCP client needs nothing but the URL. It registers itself, the user
signs in once, and it stays connected.

## What an assistant can do with it

Logging      log, log_weight, log_measurement, undo_last
Reading      brief, get_day, progress, search_log, nutrition, energy_balance
Coaching     whats_next, suggest_workout, earned_room
Live session start_session, log_set, end_session
Routines     save_routine, list_routines
Setup        get_profile, set_profile, set_goal, set_eating_window, connect_device
Memory       remember, recall

Every response is pre-computed server-side and carries a `say` string written
for reading aloud, plus a `next_actions` list. Weak and fast models work here
without doing arithmetic of their own.

## Doctrines the server ships to clients

- One sentence is a complete log. Never present a form.
- The server computes, the model relays. Never recompute a number.
- Honest, never cruel. Hard on the behaviour, never on the person.
- Estimates are labelled. Calories from a described meal are inferred.
- Care flags outrank everything, including the honesty doctrine.
- Not a medical device. No diagnosis, ever.

## Data

Ingest    POST https://wrought.fit/ingest  (bearer key, documented, public)
          Accepts metrics, workouts and events from Apple Health, Health
          Connect, CGMs, blood pressure cuffs, scales, lab results, or anything
          else that can POST JSON.
Export    GET  https://wrought.fit/api/export  (JSON or CSV, everything, always)
